name: The Arklon Ruins
shortDescription: The Arklon Ruins, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Old draenei ruins and a Burning Legion excavation named in the crystal-recovery assignment. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
